ui_bugs.issue: After clicking an existing appointment block (e.g. appt-block-<id>) on a seeded reminder-only appointment, data-testids 'complete-km-input' and 'appt-complete-btn' were not reachable within 30s. May be hidden until the appointment is in a specific state, or the dialog uses different testids for already-seeded demo appointments. New appointments booked via UI should be tested; retest after booking a fresh future appointment.

Clicking data-testid='twilio-check-btn' did not surface a visible success/failure toast (empty toast evaluation). Backend request appears to run but the UI does not render the result (expected 'Twilio reachable' / masked SID preview or similar).

integration_issues.issue: Setting the same file twice via Playwright's set_input_files does not re-trigger the file input's onChange (shows stale created=500/dups=0 instead of created=0/dups=500 on re-upload). This is a Playwright/HTML quirk, NOT a product bug — backend duplicate detection is verified via pytest (TestCRM::test_csv_import_and_dup_flag passes). Real users clicking Browse twice do get the dedup result.

issues: Uses browser-native <input type='date'> and <input type='time'> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Time picker components — look and feel differs from the rest of the dark UI, and on some browsers the native picker shows a light theme.

rca of the issue: Previous iteration's origin_guard 403 regression was fixed by requiring EITHER 'X-RevLoop-Client: web' header (sent by axios in frontend) OR a Bearer token. This bypasses the Origin-rewrite problem at ingress while still blocking cross-origin browser POSTs (no CSRF because that header can't be set by a plain cross-site form). Verified by: (a) backend pytest 44/44 passing with the new header; (b) full browser login + CRUD confirmed on all 3 roles from the preview URL.
